q: Does CBAM count electricity emissions for aluminium?
title: Aluminium CBAM and electricity
short: No. In the definitive period, aluminium goods are listed in Annex II of the CBAM Regulation, so only direct emissions count in their embedded emissions. Electricity used by a smelter or extruder is left out, even though smelting uses a lot of it. Cement and fertilisers are different: their electricity counts.
audience: Indian aluminium smelters, extruders and foil makers, and EU buyers checking their figures

ul: Direct emissions from anodes, fuels and process emissions, including PFCs at primary smelters.
The direct embedded emissions of precursor unwrought aluminium.

p: It does not enter the CBAM figure for aluminium, but some buyers also ask for a full product carbon footprint, where electricity is the largest part. Keep both sets of records.

sections.h: How this differs from the transitional period
p: Until 2025 importers reported indirect emissions separately. From 2026 they are dropped for aluminium.
